subject.title: Rescue: add watchdog core service and cron engine

question: Should OpenClaw core accept this rescueWatchdog cron payload and local repair command surface after rebase and live proof, or should self-healing gateway recovery stay outside core for now?
rationale: The implementation is a new core recovery capability that can restart and doctor managed profiles; unit tests cannot decide the product/security boundary or operator-risk tolerance.

options.title: Continue Core Path After Proof
options.body: Require a current-main rebase plus redacted live managed-host recovery proof, then review the core cron/security surface for merge.

options.title: Move To External/Plugin Path
options.body: Pause or close the core PR and ask for an external watchdog/plugin design unless maintainers identify a missing core API seam.

options.title: Accept Risk Now
options.body: A maintainer may choose to accept unit-level proof and own the security/availability risk, but that would bypass the current real-behavior proof gate.

recommendation.title: Continue Core Path After Proof
recommendation.body: Require a current-main rebase plus redacted live managed-host recovery proof, then review the core cron/security surface for merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete appears in current cron feature history and VISION.md/product direction is central to the core-vs-plugin security decision.
